    • deduplicate

      protected static List<org.cyclops.commoncapabilities.api.capability.recipehandler.IRecipeDefinition> deduplicate(List<org.cyclops.commoncapabilities.api.capability.recipehandler.IRecipeDefinition> recipes)
      Remove duplicates while preserving order. The crafting network drops a recipe from its index as soon as one removal is requested for it, so the same recipe must never be added twice from a single interface.
